name: theme
title: agentui theme
description: Graphite: shadcn/ui's neutral theme in the system's fonts (the platform's UI and monospace faces, not Geist, then its faces for Chinese, Japanese and Korean: PingFang SC, Hiragino Sans and Apple SD Gothic Neo on Apple's, Microsoft YaHei, Yu Gothic UI and Malgun Gothic on Windows, Noto Sans CJK elsewhere), drawn antialiased, a quarter em between CJK and Latin letters or digits (text-autospace, not in code), with a third, fainter text grey (`subtle-foreground`, `text-subtle-foreground`: placeholders, counts, times, labels, set at 4.5:1 or more on the background, cards, popovers and the sidebar), for base-nova in pure greys (no accent colour, a darker sidebar under an inset page in dark), with WCAG 2.2 AA contrast (but for text fields' edges: a lighter `field` grey, border-field, for Input, Textarea, Select, InputGroup and the like, their focus a bright edge and ring; checkboxes, radios and switches keep `input`, 3:1), success, warning and info colours, distinguishable chart colours, Windows high contrast support, native controls and scrollbars in the current colour scheme, a hairline lift for what is selected on a grey ground (shadow-raised: the active tab, the rail's current area), a soft shadow for what floats (shadow-float, and shadcn's shadow-md and shadow-lg: the composer, menus, popovers, find bars, toasts) and a deeper one under dialogs over a darker overlay in dark, grey menu icons and text selection, dimmed disabled accordion and radio items, icon lines 1.5px at any size (an outline icon whose paths carry their own stroke, as Hugeicons' do), a shimmer whose band is seen on any text it sweeps, in either theme: toward stronger contrast, or on text already at the text's colour away from it (shadcn's fades text almost into a light background; its band, and this theme's before, could not be seen on the text's own colour), paused out of view where an element carries `data-shimmer-paused` (use-shimmer-pause sets it), scroll fades that do not restyle a scrolling element's content as it scrolls, and a type scale of named steps (text-2xs 11px, text-2sm 13px, text-md 15px, text-display 22px for a page's one heading, text-readout 32px for a short code read out, with their line heights) rounded-xs on the radius ladder (4px) and rounded-composer (16px, the composer's box), so that components use no pixel values of their own, `touch-target`, a positioned element's place 44px at least where the pointer is a finger (`pointer: coarse`), syntax colours for code (--code-keyword, --code-string, --code-number, --code-function, --code-type, --code-tag, --code-property, --code-comment and their code-* classes, 4.5:1 or more where code is shown, greys under [data-code-tone=graphite]), and a moment's mark (animate-highlight: the accent fading out over 1.2s, for a message the reader was taken to), a height a share of the window's (max-h-dvh-60: 60dvh, for what scrolls in itself, as a long card, with overflow-y-auto and tabIndex={0} for the keyboard), one timing for motion, by name (motion-hover 100ms for a row's background as the pointer comes, given to menu, select, combobox, command and composer-select items; motion-fade 150ms; motion-size 200ms; motion-slide 400ms for a sheet, a drawer, a toast; motion-pop for a popup, in at 150ms on --ease-enter and out at 100ms on --ease-exit; four curves: --ease-ui in place, --ease-enter, --ease-exit and --ease-slide, a finger's sheet; Tailwind's bare transitions and its ease-out, ease-in and ease-in-out are the theme's, and the accordion's), a loading state seen only past a wait (animate-wait-in: unseen for --motion-wait, 300ms, then faded in), a skeleton's pulse on --motion-pulse (2s) and --ease-loop, none where the reader asks for less motion (the pulse stopped too, the wait kept); room for what covers the window's edges (pb-safe, pb-safe-or-<n>, bottom-safe-offset-<n> for the home indicator; pt-safe-or-<n>, top-safe-offset-<n> for AgentApp's titlebar or the status bar), grid-cols-icon and grid-cols-icon-end (a 16px icon's column, the rest and an end), --line-mark (1.5px, the line that marks: icons' strokes, a selected cell's edge), bg-checkerboard and bg-dot-grid. An app's palette sets seven base roles (background, foreground, primary, accent, sidebar, border, ring) on :root in a CSS file of its own; the rest are derived from them. `frame` (bg-frame) is the window's colour around an AgentApp's card, its titlebar and rail: in light a step darker than the sidebar (4% of the text's into it, as a desktop app's chrome), muted text 4.5:1 on it; in dark the sidebar's. html is painted in the background, for a native shell to follow. short: is a named variant for a screen under 30rem tall (a phone on its side), as a drawer's footer uses. ::highlight(mark) and ::highlight(mark-current) are named CSS Custom Highlights, a search's matches and the one it is at, in --mark and --mark-current (a highlight of a component's own name takes those colours). shadow-mark-start marks a current row at its start edge (--line-mark, in the text's colour); shadow-rule rules a bar off below without taking room. With a Window Controls Overlay (the app's <html data-window-controls-overlay>, or a PWA's display-mode) and no AgentApp titlebar, the window's own buttons keep their place: a sidebar's header and the rail start under env(titlebar-area-height), the sidebar's bar and a header at the window's edge start past env(titlebar-area-x), the sidebar's edge rail and the skip link under them.

theme.font-sans: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", system-ui, "Helvetica Neue", Arial, "PingFang SC", "Hiragino Sans", "Apple SD Gothic Neo", "Microsoft YaHei", "Yu Gothic UI", "Malgun Gothic", "Noto Sans CJK SC", "Noto Sans CJK JP", "Noto Sans CJK KR", sans-serif
theme.font-mono: "SF Mono", ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, "Liberation Mono", monospace

light.frame: oklch(from color-mix(in oklch, var(--foreground) 4%, var(--sidebar)) l c h / alpha)
light.card: oklch(from var(--background) l c h / alpha)
light.popover: oklch(from var(--background) l c h / alpha)
light.card-foreground: oklch(from var(--foreground) l c h / alpha)
light.popover-foreground: oklch(from var(--foreground) l c h / alpha)
light.secondary-foreground: oklch(from var(--foreground) l c h / alpha)
light.accent-foreground: oklch(from var(--foreground) l c h / alpha)
light.sidebar-foreground: oklch(from var(--foreground) l c h / alpha)
light.sidebar-accent-foreground: oklch(from var(--foreground) l c h / alpha)
light.primary-foreground: oklch(from var(--background) l c h / alpha)
light.sidebar-primary: oklch(from var(--primary) l c h / alpha)
light.sidebar-primary-foreground: oklch(from var(--primary-foreground) l c h / alpha)
light.sidebar-border: oklch(from var(--border) l c h / alpha)
light.sidebar-ring: oklch(from var(--ring) l c h / alpha)
light.code-comment: oklch(from var(--muted-foreground) l c h / alpha)
light.secondary: oklch(from color-mix(in oklch, var(--foreground) 5.7%, var(--background)) l c h / alpha)
light.muted: oklch(from color-mix(in oklch, var(--foreground) 3.8%, var(--background)) l c h / alpha)
light.muted-foreground: oklch(from color-mix(in oklch, var(--foreground) 63%, var(--background)) l c h / alpha)
light.subtle-foreground: oklch(from color-mix(in oklch, var(--foreground) 58%, var(--background)) l c h / alpha)
light.input: oklch(from color-mix(in oklch, var(--foreground) 45%, var(--background)) l c h / alpha)
light.field: oklch(from color-mix(in oklch, var(--foreground) 15%, var(--background)) l c h / alpha)
light.sidebar-accent: oklch(from var(--accent) l c h / alpha)
light.sidebar-tree: oklch(from color-mix(in oklch, var(--foreground) 25%, var(--background)) l c h / alpha)
light.shadow-float: 0 0 0 1px color-mix(in oklch, var(--foreground) 7%, transparent), 0 1px 2px color-mix(in oklch, var(--foreground) 5%, transparent), 0 6px 20px -4px color-mix(in oklch, var(--foreground) 8%, transparent)
light.shadow-dialog: 0 2px 4px color-mix(in oklch, var(--foreground) 5%, transparent), 0 24px 64px -8px color-mix(in oklch, var(--foreground) 22%, transparent)

dark.frame: oklch(from var(--sidebar) l c h / alpha)
dark.card: oklch(from color-mix(in oklch, var(--foreground) 5.3%, var(--background)) l c h / alpha)
dark.popover: oklch(from color-mix(in oklch, var(--foreground) 7%, var(--background)) l c h / alpha)
dark.card-foreground: oklch(from var(--foreground) l c h / alpha)
dark.popover-foreground: oklch(from var(--foreground) l c h / alpha)
dark.secondary-foreground: oklch(from var(--foreground) l c h / alpha)
dark.accent-foreground: oklch(from var(--foreground) l c h / alpha)
dark.sidebar-foreground: oklch(from var(--foreground) l c h / alpha)
dark.sidebar-accent-foreground: oklch(from var(--foreground) l c h / alpha)
dark.primary-foreground: oklch(from var(--background) l c h / alpha)
dark.sidebar-primary: oklch(from var(--primary) l c h / alpha)
dark.sidebar-primary-foreground: oklch(from var(--primary-foreground) l c h / alpha)
dark.sidebar-border: oklch(from var(--border) l c h / alpha)
dark.sidebar-ring: oklch(from var(--ring) l c h / alpha)
dark.code-comment: oklch(from var(--muted-foreground) l c h / alpha)
dark.secondary: oklch(from color-mix(in oklch, var(--foreground) 9.3%, var(--background)) l c h / alpha)
dark.muted: oklch(from color-mix(in oklch, var(--foreground) 12.3%, var(--background)) l c h / alpha)
dark.muted-foreground: oklch(from color-mix(in oklch, var(--foreground) 68.5%, var(--background)) l c h / alpha)
dark.subtle-foreground: oklch(from color-mix(in oklch, var(--foreground) 60%, var(--background)) l c h / alpha)
dark.input: oklch(from color-mix(in oklch, var(--foreground) 40%, transparent) l c h / alpha)
dark.field: oklch(from color-mix(in oklch, var(--foreground) 15%, transparent) l c h / alpha)
dark.sidebar-accent: oklch(from color-mix(in oklch, var(--foreground) 10.3%, var(--sidebar)) l c h / alpha)
dark.sidebar-tree: oklch(from color-mix(in oklch, var(--foreground) 32%, transparent) l c h / alpha)
dark.shadow-float: 0 0 0 1px color-mix(in oklch, var(--foreground) 7%, transparent), 0 1px 2px oklch(0 0 0 / 50%), 0 8px 24px -4px oklch(0 0 0 / 60%)

:root.--shimmer-color: oklch(from currentColor clamp(0, calc(l - 0.35 + 0.75 * round(up, 0.3 - l, 1)), 1) c h)

.dark.--shimmer-color: oklch(from currentColor clamp(0, calc(l + 0.3 - 0.75 * round(up, l - 0.8, 1)), 1) c h)
